title: The Real Reason You Can 'Feel' Someone Staring At You
description: Ever felt like someone was watching you and turned around to find out you were right? This is the real, science-backed explanation — how your peripheral vision and an ancient threat-detection reflex in your brain pick up on a stare before you're even consciously aware of it. AI-narrated original commentary inspired by a trending psychology topic, not a summary of any other video. #psychology #brainfacts #shorts #science #humanbehavior

hook_candidates.text: That 'sixth sense' for feeling eyes on you isn't psychic — it's your peripheral vision doing something wild you never noticed.
Ever spun around in a public place completely certain someone was staring — and they actually were?
Your brain can register that someone's eyes are locked on you before a single conscious thought about it even forms.
Researchers once tracked people walking through a crowd and found they reliably sensed a stranger's stare — without ever looking straight at them.
